description: V2 + Sentinel-1 radar ONLY (clean multi-sensor point for the data-regime sweep)
batch_size_note: Evaluation on this benchmark is batch-size dependent: pad_collate pads the temporal axis to the per-batch maximum. A result without its batch size is not reproducible. See docs/REPRODUCTION_GATE.md
precision_note: Training uses bf16 autocast and gradient accumulation to fit an 8.5 GB card. EVALUATION runs in fp32 at the pinned batch size, so every reported metric is computed exactly as the reproduction gate computed it.
